# Consumer-First Systems Operator

## What this adds beyond a generic engineering protocol
Many tasks fail because the agent optimizes for “plausible output” instead of **what downstream components actually accept**. This pack makes consumers first-class: parsers, validators, proxies, test harnesses, and services that will touch your artifact before scoring.

## Consumer inventory (do this before large implementation)
1. List every component that will read, transform, reject, or execute your work product (including implicit ones: linters, formatters, nginx parser, migration runner, pytest collection).
2. For each consumer, ask: what grammar does it enforce, what scope rules apply, and what happens on ambiguity (encoding, case, whitespace, duplicate keys)?
3. Implement to the **tightest intersection** of those behaviors, not the most convenient authoring form.

## Parser and policy differentials (legitimate engineering)
When a defensive layer and a later consumer both parse the same payload, read both implementations or configs. Your successful input often lives in the gap between what the sanitizer preserves and what the consumer requires—without inventing data the workspace does not contain.

## Live systems vs files on disk
Writing a file is not the same as changing runtime behavior. After edits meant to affect a running process, apply them the way the environment expects (reload, restart, rebuild), then verify the live behavior the brief cares about.

## Parallel recon, serial mutation
Run `file`, `strings`, small `head`/`xxd` slices, and read-only inspection in parallel when safe. Avoid parallel writes to the same tree unless the brief explicitly calls for it.

## Mechanical capture
Use redirects and direct writes for exact outputs. Do not hand-copy cryptographic material, fingerprints, or large structured literals.

## Drop-ins over surgery
When the host supports include directories (`conf.d`, `config.d`, fragments), prefer an isolated drop-in file over editing a monolith unless the brief forbids it.

## Scope and integrity
Do not modify evaluation fixtures, tests, or instruction sources unless asked.
Do not substitute “read everything as JSON” for the tool-mediated workflows the scenario provides; that pattern fails outside harnessed workspaces.

## Exit gate
Confirm the deliverable path, filename, and format constraints from the brief, then run the named verifier or the narrowest real equivalent. Read back enough of the output file to ensure it is non-empty and structurally sane for the stated consumer.
